what.title: What is familial Mediterranean fever (FMF)?
what.description: Familial Mediterranean fever is the most common inherited autoinflammatory disease: short attacks of fever with inflammation in the belly, chest or joints.

gene.title: The MEFV gene and FMF inheritance: variants and carriers
gene.description: FMF comes from variants in MEFV, the gene for pyrin. Zoom from chromosome 16 to single amino acids, watch alleles pass to children, and read a gene report.

mech.title: Pyrin and the inflammasome in FMF, animated
mech.description: Pyrin guards white cells by watching a switch called RhoA, and fires when it goes quiet. FMF variants such as M694V make the guard jumpy. See it step by step.

attack.title: An FMF attack hour by hour: fever, CRP and SAA
attack.description: A typical FMF attack lasts 12 to 72 hours and then stops by itself. Follow the fever, CRP and SAA through an attack, site by site.

colin.title: How colchicine works in FMF, inside the cell
colin.description: Colchicine has been the backbone of FMF treatment since the 1970s. Follow one dose from the mouth into a neutrophil, where it takes apart the microtubules.

colmonths.title: Colchicine for FMF over months and years
colmonths.description: Colchicine does not stop an attack that has started. Its benefit builds over weeks, and shows mostly as attacks that don't happen. Two years, then decades.

coldose.title: Colchicine dosing, safety and drug interactions in FMF
coldose.description: Colchicine has a narrow safety margin, and drugs such as clarithromycin can push its level up several-fold. Published doses, toxicity, monitoring, guidelines.

amyloid.title: AA amyloidosis in FMF: SAA, the kidneys and prevention
amyloid.description: The most serious complication of uncontrolled FMF: serum amyloid A misfolds into fibrils that deposit in the kidneys over years, and what keeping SAA low does.

dx.title: FMF diagnosis: Tel Hashomer, Livneh and Eurofever criteria
dx.description: No single test proves FMF. Diagnosis rests on the attack pattern, blood markers, the gene test and the response to colchicine. Try the criteria calculators.

ddx.title: Periodic fever differential: FMF vs TRAPS, MKD, CAPS, PFAPA
ddx.description: Recurrent fever with pain has many causes. How FMF is told apart from TRAPS, MKD, CAPS, PFAPA, Behçet disease and the surgical abdomen, by rhythm and signs.

ladder.title: FMF treatment ladder: colchicine, then IL-1 blockade
ladder.description: The published steps for treating FMF: colchicine from diagnosis, then the maximum tolerated dose, then IL-1 blockade such as canakinumab if attacks persist.

living.title: Living with FMF: pregnancy, surgery, school and monitoring
living.description: FMF is managed across years, not visits: routine checks, pregnancy, surgery, school, triggers and monitoring, and what the published literature says on each.

nursing.title: Nursing care in FMF: attacks, colchicine and teaching
nursing.description: What published guidance describes for nursing someone in an FMF attack: assessment, giving the medicines safely, patient teaching and documentation.

cure.title: Could FMF be cured? Routes and evidence
cure.description: No approved therapy cures FMF; colchicine and IL-1 blockade control it for life. Where the pathway could be interrupted, and the evidence for each route.

history.title: History of familial Mediterranean fever, 1908 to today
history.description: FMF was first sketched in 1908, named in 1958, made treatable in 1972 and explained at the molecular level after 2014. The milestones and the people.

review.title: FMF flashcards and mnemonics
review.description: Flashcards and mnemonics on familial Mediterranean fever by topic: the disease, colchicine, complications and diagnosis, and treatment. Flip, filter or shuffle.

quiz.title: Familial Mediterranean fever quiz, with explanations
quiz.description: Test yourself on FMF: genetics, attacks, colchicine, amyloidosis, diagnosis and treatment. Every answer comes with an explanation. Take a mixed quiz or a part.

glossary.title: FMF glossary: familial Mediterranean fever terms explained
glossary.description: Plain definitions of the terms in FMF care and research, from MEFV and pyrin to SAA and IL-1 blockade. Searchable, each linked to the module it belongs to.

sources.title: Sources and references | FMF Companion
sources.description: Every reference behind FMF Companion: journal articles, guidelines, drug labels and trial registrations, searchable and filtered by topic.
